blocks.text: WUHAN–Marta Kostyuk’s chances of qualifying for a maiden WTA Finals dwindled on Tuesday as the world No. 10 crashed out of the second round 4-6, 6-2, 6-2 to Maria Sakkari in the Wuhan Open. Kostyuk is in the running for one of the two remaining qualification spots in the eight-player field at next month’s season finale in Indian Wells but needed a strong showing in Wuhan to strengthen her odds.
